versions.content: BSW inter-partition sender-receiver communication Type: valid Description: The BSWMDT shall provide means to specify required and provided data for inter-partition and/or inter-core communication within BSW. These shall allow the corresponding BSW Scheduler API to be generated. Rationale: Optimize load balancing between the cores w.r.t. BSW services. Increase efficiency of BSW service execution. Enable optimization of multi core SW distribution. 5 34 of 47  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 86: AUTOSAR_RS_BSWModuleDescriptionTemplate Requirements on Basic Software Module Description Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Dependencies:  Use Case: Parallel execution of applications on a multi-core system.
